name: Godot StarPort strike event live acceptance fixture
description: Seeds one disposable StarPort and keeps the serving server available for the real Godot UI attack test.

tests.name: Move ordinary player, ship and port into an unprotected test sector

data.sql: WITH target AS (SELECT MIN(s.sector_id) AS sector_id FROM sectors s WHERE s.sector_id>10 AND NOT EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM ports other WHERE other.is_active AND other.sector_id=s.sector_id AND other.port_id<>9)), moved_port AS (UPDATE ports SET sector_id=(SELECT sector_id FROM target),is_active=TRUE,durability=1,defensive_strength=1 WHERE port_id=9 RETURNING sector_id), moved_player AS (UPDATE players SET sector_id=(SELECT sector_id FROM moved_port) WHERE name='planet_gov' RETURNING player_id), moved_ship AS (UPDATE ships SET sector_id=(SELECT sector_id FROM moved_port),shields=1000,fighters=100,hull=100 WHERE ship_id=(SELECT ship_id FROM players WHERE name='planet_gov') RETURNING ship_id), set_turns AS (UPDATE turns SET turns_remaining=10 WHERE player_id=(SELECT player_id FROM moved_player) RETURNING player_id), stock AS (INSERT INTO entity_stock(entity_type,entity_id,commodity_code,quantity,price) VALUES('port',9,'ORE',17,1) ON CONFLICT(entity_type,entity_id,commodity_code) DO UPDATE SET quantity=17 RETURNING quantity) SELECT ((SELECT COUNT(*) FROM moved_port)=1 AND (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM moved_player)=1 AND (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM moved_ship)=1 AND (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM set_turns)=1 AND (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM stock)=1)::int;

tests.name: Allow real Godot UI acceptance to attack the seeded StarPort
Confirm the live attack consumed the port, stock and one turn and persisted one event and receipt

data.sql: SELECT (SELECT is_active=FALSE AND durability=0 FROM ports WHERE port_id=9)::int, (SELECT quantity=0 FROM entity_stock WHERE entity_type='port' AND entity_id=9 AND commodity_code='ORE')::int, (SELECT COUNT(*)=1 FROM v3_port_action_receipts r JOIN players p USING(player_id) WHERE p.name='planet_gov' AND r.action='attack' AND r.result->>'destroyed'='true')::int, (SELECT COUNT(*)=1 FROM player_events e JOIN players p USING(player_id) WHERE p.name='planet_gov' AND e.event_type='player.port_strike.v1')::int, (SELECT COUNT(*)=1 FROM v3_port_action_receipts r JOIN players p USING(player_id) WHERE p.name='planet_gov' AND r.action='attack')::int, (SELECT turns_remaining=499 FROM turns t JOIN players p USING(player_id) WHERE p.name='planet_gov')::int;
